function.arguments: {"message":"Hi there! Our API rate limit is applied per API key using a rolling 60‑second window, not a fixed per‑minute bucket. That means the requests you made in the last 60 seconds are counted continuously. Even if your average rate is below the headline limit, a burst of calls can push you over the limit and trigger a `429` response. You can see exactly how many requests remain and when the window resets in the response headers `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Spreading your calls more evenly over time should prevent the early throttling."}
